{{Quote|A Droid Farm?? He actually planted droid parts in the ground and expected droids to grow from them? Amazing! I may have to do a story on that guy. I can't believe I called him a Droid Engineer.|[[Vani Korr]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP2" />}}
'''Zorajas Garamin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A very delusional individual, Garamin believed he could actually farm [[Droid/Legends|droids]] by planting them in the ground.<ref name="SWG:TMHP2" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Garamin who presented himself as a droid engineer complained to ''[[Corellia Times]]'' reporter [[Vani Korr]] that his droids were sabotaged. Interested about possible sabotage from the technology-hating [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] criminals, Korr dispatched a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate [[Zorajas Garamin's farm]]. Indeed, the spacer did not find any sabotage which could explain that the droids did not "grow".<ref name="SWG:TMHP2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zorajas Garamin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP2" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Zorajas Garamin was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
